title: Unit-aware calibration of single-cell disease associations: analysis-unit, effect-size, and graph-stability audits in human kidney atlases
description: Analysis code, unitaware v0.3.0, curated results, figures, and manuscript v45 for analysis-unit dependence, effect-size selection, calibration-stability auditing, and graph/seed/proportion/embedding sensitivity in human kidney single-cell studies. The archive includes nine main figures, three supplementary figures, and six Excel additional-file workbooks.
